update.ready: A new version of Kitroid is ready.

pos.title: Kitroid POS
pos.tagline: Sell offline. Your data stays on this device.

db.busyTitle: Kitroid POS is open in another tab
db.busyBody: Your data can only be used in one tab at a time. Close the other tab, or use it here instead.
db.movedTitle: Kitroid POS moved to another tab
db.movedBody: This tab let go of your data so another tab could use it.
db.memoryWarn: This browser cannot save files for websites (OPFS). Data is kept in browser storage instead. Please use a recent Chrome, Edge, Safari or Firefox, and back up often.

disclaimer.title: Before you start
disclaimer.p1: Kitroid POS runs entirely on this device. Your shop data is stored only in this browser, not on Kitroid's servers. Kitroid cannot see, recover or restore it.
disclaimer.p2: If you clear browser data, uninstall the app or lose this device, your data will be lost unless you have a backup. Back up to your own Google Drive or download a backup file regularly.
disclaimer.p3: Kitroid is provided free, as is, without warranty. You use it at your own risk and are responsible for your records, prices and taxes.

welcome.title: Set up your shop
welcome.backupBody: Your shop is ready. Everything you sell is saved on this device right away, even without internet.
welcome.tip1: Connect Google Drive in Backup so your data is copied to your own Google account.
welcome.tip2: Install the app: browser menu → Install app / Add to Home Screen.
welcome.tip3: Close each day in Summary to lock the day's numbers and print a Z-report.
welcome.restoreQ: Already used Kitroid on another device?

home.sellBody: One ticket per customer, with change and receipt.
home.quickBody: Tap to count everything sold today.
home.summaryBody: Daily, weekly and monthly sales. Close the day.
home.persistDenied: The browser did not allow it yet. Install the app (Add to Home Screen) and try again.
home.iosInstall: On iPhone/iPad, tap Share → Add to Home Screen. Safari may delete data of websites that are not installed.

sell.noItems: No items. Add items in Menu & shop.
sell.clearConfirm: Remove all items from this sale?
sell.notEnough: Amount received is less than the total.
sell.khqrHint: Ask the customer to scan and pay, check the amount in your bank app, then confirm.
sell.khqrMissing: Add your KHQR image in Menu & shop → Shop to show it here. Check the payment in your bank app, then confirm.
sell.dayClosed: Today is already closed. Re-open it in Summary to keep selling.
sell.debtTo: {name} will pay later. The amount is added to their account.
sell.debtNeedCustomer: Choose a customer for this sale first (top of the cart).

quick.hint: Tap an item each time one is sold. Everything is saved on this device as you tap.
quick.freeHint: Free mode: taps are recorded as give-aways or staff use. They count as items but not as money.
quick.reopened: You can edit the tally again
quick.lockedHint: This day is closed. Re-open it in Summary to change it.

setup.noItems: No items yet. Start from a ready menu, or add your own.
setup.deleteItemConfirm: Delete "{name}"? Items that were already sold are hidden instead, so old sales stay correct.
setup.barcodeTaken: Another item already uses this barcode.
setup.deleteCategoryConfirm: Delete category "{name}"? Its items are kept, without a category.
setup.addonsHint: Add-ons are choices like size, sugar or ice. Some can change the price. Attach them to items in each item's settings.
setup.templatesHint: Kitroid's recommended setups. Adding one creates its categories, items and add-ons; you can change everything afterwards.
setup.khqrHint: Take a photo or screenshot of your shop's KHQR code. It is shown to customers when they pay by KHQR.

sum.pending: {n} Quick Sales tally not submitted yet ({amount}). It is not counted until it is submitted or the day is closed.
sum.closeConfirm: Close {date}? Quick Sales are submitted, the totals are locked and no more sales can be added to that day.
sum.reopenConfirm: Re-open {date} to correct it? Close it again afterwards.
sum.voidClosed: This day is closed. Re-open it first.

bk.intro: Your data lives only on this device. Keep a copy somewhere else so a lost or broken device does not lose your shop.
bk.dirty: There are changes since the last backup.
bk.driveBody: Copies go to your own Google Drive (folder Kitroid / POS). Kitroid can only see the files it creates there.
bk.driveNotConfigured: Google Drive backup is not set up on this website yet. Use the folder or download backup for now.
bk.driveAutoNote: Automatic Drive backup runs while you are signed in (about 1 hour after you connect or tap Back up now)
bk.folderBody: Saves a backup file into a folder you choose (e.g. a USB drive or a synced folder), automatically.
bk.folderUnsupported: This browser cannot write to folders. Use Chrome or Edge on a computer, or download a backup file.
bk.downloadBody: A .zip with your database and photos. Keep it somewhere safe, or send it to yourself.
bk.restoreWarn: Restoring replaces ALL data on this device with the backup. Back up first if you are not sure.
bk.restoreConfirm: Replace all data on this device with the backup {what}?
bk.noDriveBackups: No backups found in this Google account.
bk.needSignIn: Please connect Google Drive again (tap Back up now).
bk.needPermission: Allow Kitroid to use the backup folder again.
bk.remind: Your data has not been backed up for {n} days.
bk.remindNever: Your data has not been backed up yet.

park.label: Name for this sale
park.parked: Sale parked. Resume it from Parked sales.

stock.intro: Track how many you have of the items you choose. Sales reduce stock automatically; voided sales put it back.
stock.lowCount: {n} items are low or out of stock.
stock.empty: No items are tracked yet. Tap "Track items".
stock.trackHint: Choose items to track. Then use Count to enter how many you have now.

printer.intro: Choose how this device prints receipts. Each device remembers its own printer.
printer.unsupported: Direct printing needs Chrome or Edge (computer or Android). On iPhone/iPad use the browser print dialog.
printer.systemHint: Receipts open the print dialog. Choose your receipt printer there; it works with any printer installed on this device.
printer.btHint: Turn on the printer. The first print after opening the app asks you to choose it from a list.
printer.serialHint: Plug in the printer (or pair it in Windows Bluetooth settings so it gets a COM port). The first print asks you to choose the port.
printer.paperNote: Paper width: {mm} mm (change it in Shop).

plan.needs: This feature is not in your plan.
plan.invalid: This license key is not valid.
plan.freeBody: Up to 50 items on sale. All features included.
plan.offlineNote: Keys are checked on this device, no internet needed.
plan.limitReached: The Free plan allows {max} items on sale.
plan.limitHow: Hide items you no longer sell (they don't count), or upgrade to Pro for unlimited items.
plan.templateTooBig: This menu adds {n} items. The Free plan allows {max} items on sale and you already have {used}. Hide some items or upgrade to Pro.

sync.title: Use on several devices
sync.body: Sell on several phones, tablets or PCs and see one shop: the same menu, customers, stock and combined sales. Changes travel through your own Google Drive.
sync.step1: On this device: connect Google Drive above, then turn sync on.
sync.step2: On each other device: open kitroid.com/pos → Restore a backup → From Google Drive → choose this shop.
sync.step3: Then turn sync on there too. Each device keeps its own cart and Quick Sales tally; Summary adds them all up.
sync.confirmOn: This device will send all its shop data to your Google Drive and receive changes from your other devices. Continue?
sync.signInHint: Signed out of Google: automatic sync is paused. Tap Sync now to continue.
sync.stale: This device has not synced for a long time and may have missed changes. Restore the latest backup from Google Drive, then sync.
sync.needUpdate: Another device uses a newer Kitroid. Update this app (reload) before syncing.

landing.title: Kitroid: free offline tools for Cambodian businesses
landing.description: POS, Quick Sales, income and expense, calculators and more. Runs in your browser, works offline, and your data stays on your own device.
landing.heroSub: Made for Cambodian small and medium businesses. Open in your browser, no sign-up, no server. Your data stays on your phone, tablet or PC.

why.offlineBody: After the first visit, tools open and work with no internet.
why.privateBody: Nothing is uploaded to Kitroid. Back up to your own Google Drive if you want.
why.freeBody: Core features are free. Install it like an app on any device.
why.khmerBody: Khmer and English, riel and dollar, rounded to the 100 ៛ note.

tools.posBody: Sell from a product grid or tally the day's sales. Receipts, KHQR, daily/weekly/monthly summary.
tools.financeBody: Loan, interest, instalment and profit calculators.
tools.incomeBody: Record money in and out, see your monthly profit.
tools.calcBody: Currency, margin, VAT, unit price and more.
tools.tongtinBody: Run a savings circle: members, rounds, bids and payouts.

landing.footer: Kitroid tools run on your own device at your own risk. No data is sent to Kitroid.

fin.title: Kitroid Financial calculator
fin.disclaimer: Results are estimates for planning. Your bank or lender's contract is what counts.

loan.annuityHint: Declining balance; you pay the same amount every month (most banks).
loan.principalHint: Declining balance; principal is the same each month, so payments get smaller.
loan.flatHint: Interest is always on the full original amount, even after you repay part of it.
loan.flatWarn: A flat rate of {flat}% per month costs about {real} per month on a declining balance. Compare offers using the true cost.

sav.taxHint: If tax is withheld from your interest, enter the rate here.
sav.makeup: What your savings are made of

pro.targetMarkup: Target markup (% on top of cost)
pro.hint: Margin = profit ÷ price. Markup = profit ÷ cost. Prices are rounded up to the nearest 100 ៛ or cent.
pro.loss: This price is below your cost: you lose money on each sale.

be.fixedHint: Rent, salaries, electricity, loan payments: what you pay even if you sell nothing.
be.variableHint: Ingredients, cups, packaging: what each sale costs you.
be.perDaySub: to cover your costs, open {days} days
be.impossible: Your price is not higher than the cost per item, so you can never cover your fixed costs. Raise the price or lower the cost.
be.explain: After about {units} items in a month, your {fixed} of fixed costs is covered and every further sale is profit.

money.title: Kitroid Income & Expense
money.tagline: Write down money in and out. See your profit every month. Data stays on this device.
money.rateHint: Suggested at {rate} ៛ per $1. Change it if the rate was different.
money.empty: No entries this month. Tap Money in or Money out.

welcome.title: Start your money book
welcome.name: Business name
welcome.accountsHint: Tick the ones you use and enter how much is in each today.
welcome.disclaimer: Your records are stored only on this device. If you clear the browser or lose the device they are gone, unless you back up. Kitroid cannot see or recover them. Use at your own risk.

money.currencyFixed: The currency of an account cannot change.
money.rateNote: The rate is saved with each new entry, so changing it later does not change old reports.
money.otherTab: Kitroid Income & Expense is open in another tab

bk.intro: Your book lives only on this device. Keep a copy in your Google Drive or as a file.
bk.dirty: There are changes since the last backup.
bk.driveBody: Saved in your own Google Drive: Kitroid / Income & Expense. Automatic every 30 minutes while you are signed in.
bk.notConfigured: Google Drive backup is not set up on this website yet. Download a backup file instead.
bk.signInAgain: Please sign in to Google again.
bk.downloadBody: A .zip with your book and receipt photos.
bk.restoreWarn: Restoring replaces everything on this device with the backup.
bk.restoreConfirm: Replace all data on this device with the backup {what}?
bk.notBackup: This file is not a Kitroid Income & Expense backup.
bk.remind: Your book has not been backed up for more than 3 days.

change.note: Change is rounded to the nearest 100 ៛ note.

vat.note: Cambodia's standard VAT rate is 10%. Check your own tax obligations.

disc.stackNote: Two discounts are applied one after the other: 10% + 10% = 19% off, not 20%.
